title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1982-05-21
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a tight, jam‑filled second set highlighted by a stellar Black Peter.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its concise yet satisfying second set, full of great jams and a happy band vibe, with the performance of "Black Peter" singled out as exceptional. The Sony D‑5 soundboard recording is described as crisp, full‑spectrum and virtually flawless apart from minor low‑end distortion, making it a superb listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers gave 4–5 stars, highlighting both an energetic performance and high‑quality soundboard recording; the weighted average yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, full‑spectrum sound from a Sony D‑5 recorder; minor low‑end distortion noted but not objectionable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short second set with no filler, tight transitions and plenty of engaging jams that keep the energy high.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drum solo highlighted as strong and energetic.
